title: Integral generator bijection on finite coefficient homomorphisms
statement: For a scheme T, level n and any module sheaf M over the intrinsic finite coefficient ring sheaf, precomposition with finiteQuotient after forgetting coefficients, f ↦ finiteQuotient ≫ forget(f), is a bijection from module maps out of the evaluated regular coefficient module to maps of abelian sheaves out of the constant sheaf ℤ into forget(M).

proof.text: Module maps out of the regular module are global sections of M by evaluation at one (after the coefficient evaluation unit identification); maps out of the constant sheaf ℤ are global sections of forget(M) by the constant-sheaf adjunction at the terminal object. The section formula of finiteQuotient sends 1 to 1 and the evaluation unit sends 1 to 1, so the displayed map is the composite of these two bijections.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotient_hom_bijective (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (SemilinearSections.ring.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (SpTowerShriek.B l E T n))) :
    Function.Bijective (fun f :
      (SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n).obj (coefficient T (Arings l E T)) ⟶ M ↦
        finiteQuotient l E T n ≫ (finiteForget l E T n).map f)
